question: For fixed-background V(phi)=0 scalar matter in the declared zonal unit-S3 basis, does the exact continuum H_phi-H_phi identity agree with the matter momentum functional before a hard scalar-mode projection, and what is the separately recorded finite-cutoff difference?

primary_sources.source: Repository closed-S3 ADM linear scalar convention audit
primary_sources.used_for: q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab, V(phi)=0 scalar normalization and the shared ADM sign convention
primary_sources.not_used_for: the gravitational constraint, lapse/shift elimination or a full HDA derivation

primary_sources.source: Repository zonal scalar convolution cutoff ledger
primary_sources.used_for: the normalized zonal Q_n Chebyshev-U product and hard-cutoff convention
primary_sources.not_used_for: a complete scalar-vector-tensor basis or nonzonal Gaunt data

primary_sources.source: R. Arnowitt, S. Deser and C. W. Misner, The Dynamics of General Relativity (1962)
primary_sources.used_for: the canonical scalar normal and momentum constraint conventions
primary_sources.not_used_for: a proof that this restricted finite-mode calculation closes the full gravitational constraint algebra

upstream_results.role: pins q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab and the V=0 scalar normalization
pins normalized zonal products and the non-anomalous hard-cutoff remainder vocabulary
pins the V=0 scalar normal-density convention and its explicit non-full-ADM boundary

declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3, Vol=2*pi^2, Q_n=U_n(cos chi)/sqrt(2*pi^2), Delta Q_n=-n(n+2)Q_n, and integral Q_i Q_j=delta_ij
declared_conventions.background: q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab with a>0 spatially constant; theta and xi are canonical scalar configuration and momentum coefficients in phi=sum theta_n Q_n and pi_phi=sqrt(gamma) sum xi_n Q_n
declared_conventions.canonical_bracket: {theta_i,xi_j}=delta_ij and all theta-theta and xi-xi brackets vanish
declared_conventions.matter_constraints: H_phi[N]=(1/2) integral sqrt(gamma) N[a^(-3) xi^2+a |D theta|^2], D_phi[v]=integral sqrt(gamma) xi v^a D_a theta
declared_conventions.hh_target: {H_phi[N],H_phi[M]}=D_phi[v_NM] with v_NM^a=a^(-2)(N D^a M-M D^a N)
declared_conventions.ambient_control: For retained field cutoff L, the full-before-project control differentiates H_phi in an ambient coefficient space through L+max(deg N,deg M), then substitutes all ambient modes above L to zero; the L-only bracket is a separately declared projected calculation.
declared_conventions.hard_cutoff: The residual full-before-project minus L-only is a finite scalar-mode projection remainder. It is recorded with support and must not be called a continuum algebra failure, a classical anomaly or a quantum anomaly.

smearings.purpose: smallest distinct nonconstant zonal lapse pair with a nonzero gradient deformation vector

exact_plan: hash-verify every upstream result and retain its scope boundaries
derive the fixed-background scalar H_phi and D_phi from the stated canonical convention without adding gravitational variables
derive exact zonal triple and gradient Gaunt identities and cross-check their low-mode values by direct chi integration
evaluate the HH bracket in an ambient mode space before substituting the declared low-mode packet
evaluate the separately projected L-only canonical bracket, compare each with D_phi[v_NM], and retain full-minus-projected support exactly
leave full ADM, DD/DH brackets, Jacobi, BFV, anomaly, physical and TOE outputs null

decision_table.condition: all upstream pins and exact identities pass
decision_table.meaning: the result is restricted to fixed-background zonal scalar matter and does not establish the full hypersurface-deformation algebra

decision_table.condition: an upstream pin or exact identity fails
decision_table.meaning: reject this convention packet without inferring a failure of continuum GR or a quantum anomaly
